note: Track is not immediately obvious as it has been ploughed over and planted with grass
This little section is a UCR, and in use by the 4x4 communiity.
Used frequently by off-road clubs. ORPA on OS maps.

Very little to see on ground in terms of evidence that this is used as a byway or bridlepath. Seems to be used only as a footpath, as there was evidence of foot traffic. Still very unclear where the right of way actually goes, no signage on ground.

As of May 2022, Gloucestershire County Council still classes this as a BOAT. The section of the path that runs broadly east-west is narrow with encroaching vegetation. Vehicular access (except perhaps for a determined cyclist) seems impossible.
